name: suica-pay
description: Suica Pay customer application and World verification handoff
customHeaders:
customHeaders:
  - pattern: '**/*'
    headers:
      - key: X-Content-Type-Options
        value: nosniff
      - key: Referrer-Policy
        value: no-referrer
      - key: X-Frame-Options
        value: DENY
  - pattern: '/v1/*'
    headers:
      - key: Cache-Control
        value: private, no-store
  - pattern: '/verify'
    headers:
      - key: Cache-Control
        value: no-store
